title: Jake Barber in the GATE program as a child

tellings.quote: >> I was in the gate program as a kid. Gate program is a program that it's an acronym for gifted and talented education

plain: Jake Barber says he was put in the GATE programme as a child, an acronym for "gifted and talented education", a school track for bright children. He tells Michels this as part of his own story, which he frames as having been picked out as a child by the government's secret UFO programme. If so, such school programmes would have served as a way to spot children for that work.
